text: DeepSeek Meme 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的本地表情包插件，在聊天输入区加入表情按钮和贴纸面板，并提供模型可调用的 send_sticker 工具。用户可以浏览默认与社区贴纸包，创建自己的表情包，上传 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF 图片，编辑名称、含义和标签，也可以移动或删除贴纸；点击贴纸会作为图片消息发送，模型则可查询目录并选择表情回复。它适合希望在 DSH 对话中用图片表达反应、管理个人贴纸库并让模型理解贴纸含义的用户。配置可将数据目录设为自定义位置，默认保存在 DSH_HOME 下的 memes 目录；插件代码未要求额外 API 密钥。

DeepSeek Meme adds a sticker picker to DSH web chat and a send_sticker tool for the model. Users can browse bundled packs, create packs, upload images, edit sticker meanings, and send stickers as image messages. The local library defaults to DSH_HOME/memes or ~/.dsh/memes; no API key is required.
想在 DSH 聊天输入框旁边加个表情包按钮。
我想自己整理和管理聊天用的贴纸。
能不能上传图片做成表情，再给它加上含义和标签？
让模型也能在聊天里挑一张贴纸发给我。
想在 DSH 会话里用表情图片代替纯文字回应。
I want a sticker picker inside the chat composer.
Can I upload my own images and organize them into sticker packs?
Let the model choose and send a sticker as a chat reply.
DeepSeek Meme 的功能「面板发送贴纸」：输入区按钮打开贴纸面板，用户点选贴纸后作为图片消息发进当前会话。
DeepSeek Meme 的功能「管理个人贴纸库」：用户可以新建表情包、上传图片，并修改贴纸信息、移动或删除贴纸。
DeepSeek Meme 的功能「模型发送表情」：模型通过 send_sticker 工具先查看贴纸目录，再按贴纸 ID 发送一张表情图片并附带名称和含义。
DeepSeek Meme 的功能「贴纸包初始化」：首次加载时读取随插件提供的清单和图片，把默认包及社区包加入本地贴纸目录。
dsh-deepseek-meme 提供工具 send_sticker：Send a sticker image to the user. Call with action="list" to inspect available stickers, then action="send" with a stickerId.

dsh-deepseek-meme README · 为什么做这个：DSH 的对话里一直没有“表情包”这个位置：用户只能打字，模型看不懂别人贴的图，也谈不上用表情回话。DeepSeek Meme 把这件事做成聊天的一部分：

- **点一下就能发**：模型选择栏旁的表情按钮，打开面板，点贴纸立即发送。
- **只发图片**：贴纸以纯图片消息进入会话，不带含义文字；发送时缩到 180px，明显小于普通图片。
- **模型看得懂**：每个贴纸都有 `name / meaning / tags`，模型可以看图理解，也可以查目录精确确认。
- **模型也能发**：`send_sticker` 工具让模型主动挑一张贴纸回你，并以 150px 内联小图出现在回复里。
- **表情包是自己的**：面板里可以新建包、添加图片、改名称/含义/标签、移动和删除；数据只在本机。

| 添加贴纸 | PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF；上传时自动校验格式与大小 |

dsh-deepseek-meme README · 使用：1. 在对话输入区点击 🐋 表情按钮。
2. 选择一个表情包标签页，点击贴纸即可发送。
3. 悬停贴纸右上角的 ✎ 可以编辑名称、含义、标签、所属包，或删除。
4. 点击「＋ 添加表情」选择本地图片；点击「＋」新建表情包。
5. 和模型聊天时，模型也可以通过 `send_sticker` 主动回发表情。

**用户发送**：只发图片，不带说明文字；图片会缩到 180px 再进入会话。

**模型发送**：工具结果带一张 150px 内联 Markdown 小图，直接出现在回复里；同时保留可点击放大的 durable attachment。

dsh-deepseek-meme README · DeepSeek Meme：English · [简体中文](README.md) A sticker library for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: a composer button and panel, two bundled sticker packs, and a `send_sticker` tool the model can understand and reply with.

dsh-deepseek-meme README · DeepSeek Meme：> Listed in the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/FeWOO/DeepSeek-meme/) community catalog.

dsh-deepseek-meme README · Why：DSH chat has no sticker surface: users type, models cannot read pasted images, and there is no way to answer with a sticker. DeepSeek Meme makes stickers a first-class part of the conversation:

dsh-deepseek-meme README · Why：- **One click to send** — a sticker button next to the model selector; pick a sticker and it is posted immediately.
- **Image-only messages** — sticker messages contain just the image, scaled to 180px so they feel smaller than ordinary attachments.
- **Model-readable** — every sticker carries `name / meaning / tags`; the model can understand the image and look up the catalog when it needs precision.
- **Model can send too** — the `send_sticker` tool lets the model choose a sticker and reply with a 150px inline image.
- **Bring your own packs** — create packs, add images, edit names/meanings/tags, move or delete stickers; everything stays local.

dsh-deepseek-meme README · Features：| Area | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Composer button | `conversation.input.right`, between the model selector and submit |
| Sticker panel | `conversation.input.dock`: pack tabs, grid, add/edit/delete |
| Send behavior | 180px image-only user message (`messageStickerSize`, 96–240) |
| Add stickers | PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF with type and size validation |
| Edit stickers | Name, meaning, tags, pack; meanings stay in the model-readable catalog |
| Model tool | `send_sticker` list/send; expanded tool card + 150px inline Markdown image |
| Bundled packs | “默认表情” (10) + “鲸鱼娘二创梗图” (8), seeded on first run |
| Storage | `DSH_HOME/memes`; local only, no upload, no telemetry |

dsh-deepseek-meme README · Usage：1. Click the 🐋 sticker button in the composer.
2. Pick a pack tab and click a sticker to send it.
3. Hover a sticker and click ✎ to edit its name, meaning, tags, pack, or delete it.
4. Use “＋ Add sticker” to upload local images, or “＋” to create a pack.
5. The model can reply with stickers through the `send_sticker` tool.

**User-sent** stickers are image-only and scaled to 180px. **Model-sent** stickers use a 150px inline image plus a durable attachment.

dsh-deepseek-meme README · Bundled packs：- **默认表情 `whale-gpt` (10)** — 收到！ / 谢谢你~ / 我来啦！ / 辛苦啦 / 晚安安 / 早安~ / 喝奶茶中... / 嗯…? / 哼！ / 好困…
- **鲸鱼娘二创梗图 `whale-community` (8)** — community fan art; copyright remains with the original artists. See [docs/ASSETS.md](docs/ASSETS.md).

Both packs are independent; add or remove `assets/*/manifest.json` directories to add or remove bundled packs.

dsh-deepseek-meme README · Architecture：- **Host**: local sticker store, `/api/memes/*` routes, `send_sticker`, system-prompt section.
- **Client**: `conversation.input.right` button, `conversation.input.dock` panel, `tool.call.toolview` view.
- **Data**: `DSH_HOME/memes/catalog.json` + `assets/`, atomic writes, serialized mutations, multi-bundle sync.
- **Sessions**: user stickers are normal `user/message` image blocks; model stickers are tool results plus an inline image. No fake session event types.
dsh-deepseek-meme README · Architecture：See [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and [docs/API.md](docs/API.md).

dsh-deepseek-meme README · Privacy：Reads and writes only `DSH_HOME/memes`. No network fetches for sticker assets, no uploads, no telemetry. Image processing uses DSH attachment services; uploads are media-type and size checked; SVG is rejected.

dsh-deepseek-meme README · Compatibility：Targets DSH **0.2.1-rc.2**. Verified: dual-pack seeding, catalog/asset routes, sticker CRUD, 180px user sends, 150px inline model sends, community listing. See [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md).
